title: ADA Compliant Grab Bar 63-Inch 3-Post Wall Mount Iron Pipe | Oil Rubbed Bronze | Allied Brass
short_title: ADA Compliant Grab Bar 63-Inch | Allied Brass, Oil Rubbed Bronze
description:
Add steady support to the bathroom with this ADA compliant grab bar featuring a three-post design for enhanced stability and a long 63-inch length in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom. From the Pipeline collection, it brings an industrial pipe look that coordinates with transitional bathroom hardware while helping improve confidence and balance near the shower, tub, or toilet.

Highlights:
- Oil Rubbed Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Choose from 19 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Wall-mount installation helps keep floor space clear
- Iron pipe construction with a highly durable powder coat finish
- Designer finish is built for corrosion-free and rust-free performance

Specs:
- Overall length: 63 in
- Height: 3 in; Width/Projection: 3.58 in
- Weight capacity: 250 lb
- Product weight: 5 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
- Multiple designer finish options available
